name: claude-floating-alert
description: Floating alert above every app when Claude Code asks for permission, asks a question or finishes a task.

commands.title: Claude Floating Alert: Show Test Alert

claudeFloatingAlert.permission.enabled.description: Show an alert when Claude asks for permission to use a tool.

claudeFloatingAlert.question.enabled.description: Show an alert when Claude asks a question (AskUserQuestion).

claudeFloatingAlert.stop.enabled.description: Show an alert when Claude finishes a task.

claudeFloatingAlert.stop.timeout.description: Seconds before the task-finished alert closes by itself (0 keeps it on screen).

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p bin && /usr/bin/xcrun swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos11 native/ClaudeAlert.swift -o bin/claude-alert
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run build:native && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --target darwin-arm64
